summary: Frontend regression for redesigned Intl Shipments overview (4-tile card + shipments board + Open Orders tab + inline messages + New Shipment). Empty-creds login -> Intl Shipments loads. All 4 KPI tiles render figures 3 / 1 / 2 / 2,670. Every specified selector and flow behaves as expected. 0 page errors, 0 horizontal overflow at 1920/1280/390 widths, tiles arrange 4 / 2x2 / stacked.

actions.is-act-mark-prepaid: prepay tile shows 0 with '$3,191 received · 2 released'; SASA row now 'Prepaid'
actions.is-act-ignore-all: msg tile shows 0 with 'Inbox clear — every message answered'

critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 475 lines and still mixes list, overview card, detail and modals. Detail view (~180 lines) is a good candidate to extract into its own file for maintainability.

is-attn-ignore-IS-0010 cannot be independently verified once is-act-ignore-all is invoked earlier in the session (all inline messages are dismissed). Consider a hidden dev reset or run this assertion before ignore-all, or split into an independent sub-test with fresh state.
'is-kpi-released' testid label on the prepay tile is semantically 'focus prepayment'. Consider renaming to is-focus-prepay to align testid semantics with visible label 'Focus/Focused'.

Filter customer/factory MultiSelect toggles ('is-filter-customer-toggle') were verified to render 3 options fully inside viewport at 1920, but there is no test coverage for menu overflow on narrow (1280) widths — recommend a lightweight regression there since the menu is right-anchored.
Recharts (if still used elsewhere) previously emitted width/height(-1) warnings; not observed on this page after the redesign — no action needed.
